headline: Omonia's perfect start meets Benfica's wins over Milan and Celtic
summary: Two teams with six points meet in Nicosia on Thursday, but the way they earned them is very different. Omonia have won both Europa League games, though the Celta Vigo win came with only 0.32 expected goals. Benfica beat Milan 2-0 away and Celtic 4-1 at home, and Marco Silva has confirmed Claudio Echeverri will start. Benfica are without Enzo Barrenechea, who has made 11 appearances. Omonia needed a stoppage-time equaliser on Monday and have had 3 days' rest. The market makes Benfica 70% favourites, rated about 1.25 goals the better side, with the goals line at 3.0.
read: Benfica arrive in Nicosia with a perfect Europa League record built on wins over AC Milan and Celtic, and the market makes them roughly a 70% favourite and about one and a third goals the better side. Omonia have also won both of their league-phase games and are unbeaten in five, but they needed a stoppage-time equaliser on Monday and were out-created at home by Celta Vigo.

facts.fact: Benfica are priced at a 70.4% fair chance to win in Nicosia, against 11.9% for Omonia — nearly six times the Cypriots' chance.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clear favourite: Benfica are expected to win, not merely to be the better team.

facts.fact: Benfica won both Europa League matches so far, 2-0 away at AC Milan and 4-1 at home to Celtic, leading 3-0 at half-time against Celtic.
facts.meaning: A perfect league-phase record against two of the biggest names in the competition, both won by two goals or more.

facts.fact: Omonia beat Celta Vigo 1-0 at home in the Europa League while creating only 0.32 xG and allowing 1.17.
facts.meaning: Their two wins from two are built on efficiency rather than control — they were out-created at home and still took the points.

facts.fact: Benfica coach Marco Silva confirmed in a press conference that Claudio Echeverri will start Thursday's match in Nicosia.
facts.meaning: Benfica's attacking setup is settled enough for the coach to name a starter a day before kick-off.

facts.fact: Benfica are without midfielder Enzo Barrenechea, who has 11 appearances this season, and Portuguese outlet O Jogo reports three players stayed behind in preparation for the trip.
facts.meaning: Benfica rotate the squad but lose a midfielder used in every phase of the season so far.

facts.fact: Omonia played a 2-2 draw with Olympiakos Nicosia on Monday, equalising in stoppage time, and have 3 days' rest before facing Benfica.
facts.meaning: Omonia come in on a short turnaround after a draining late equaliser, while Benfica have been resting since 15 October.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is +1.36 for Omonia, meaning the market rates Benfica about 1.35 goals the better side on neutral ground.
facts.meaning: Benfica are fancied to win, but the market's margin is around one and a third goals — a one-goal win would not settle the handicap in their favour.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 3.0, with Over priced at 49.6% — the market has the game almost exactly on three goals.
facts.meaning: An open game is expected: three goals is the 50/50 point, not a cagey one-goal affair.

sources.fact: Benfica coach Marco Silva confirmed in a press conference that Claudio Echeverri will start Thursday's Europa League match against Omonia Nicosia.
Portuguese outlet O Jogo reports Benfica travel to Cyprus without three players who stayed behind in preparation, and another player was also absent from the buildup.
Benfica go into the Omonia match after wins over AC Milan (2-0) and Celtic (4-1) in the Europa League.
Benfica beat Celtic 4-1 in Lisbon, leading 3-0 at half-time, with Camilo Duran scoring after the birth of his child.
Both Omonia and Benfica are described as seeking to keep a perfect record in the Europa League league phase in this third-round match.
Fredrik Aursnes has become Benfica's captain and a fan favourite, according to Sporten.
Omonia avoided defeat in stoppage time in a draw with Olympiakos Nicosia, a result Portuguese media framed as a warning for Benfica.
Omonia also won their first Europa League matches, according to O Jogo's preview of the Nicosia clash.
